summary: The change replaces Mask.npi(value) with the raw value in the annual income format-rejection log message, so unmasked NPI (annual_income is a registered NPI field) now reaches the application log, which violates LOG-1. No approved, in-scope exception covers this, so EXC-1 is also violated. The process records (ticket, independent approval on the head commit, passing CI on the head commit) are in order, but they cannot offset a critical product-obligation violation. The change is rejected.
